cr_list.cr: I need my laptop’s battery to comfortably last a full real‑world day of typical light work, school, and casual use so I don’t have to stay near a charger.
cr_list.voc: The battery has to get me through a full day of work or class away from an outlet.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop to have a modern, power-efficient CPU and integrated graphics that keep everyday work, web, video, and light gaming fast and smooth without overheating or slowing down, even on battery.
cr_list.voc: Everyday work, video, and light games should stay fast and smooth — even on battery, without running hot.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop to be light and compact enough that I can carry it around throughout the day without it feeling heavy or bulky.
cr_list.voc: I carry it around all day — it can't feel heavy or bulky.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop’s keyboard to be comfortable, accurate, and durable for long typing sessions, with a sensible layout, stable keys, well‑placed navigation, and effective backlighting where present.
cr_list.voc: A comfortable, accurate keyboard I can type on for hours — sensible layout, solid keys, good backlight.

cr_list.cr: I need my laptop to have a well-chosen, robust mix of common ports (e.g., USB-A, USB-C/Thunderbolt, HDMI/DP, audio, and sometimes Ethernet/SD) so I can connect typical peripherals and displays without relying on many dongles.
cr_list.voc: Give me the common ports I actually use — I'm not carrying a bag of dongles.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop’s display to be bright, low-glare, and comfortable to view in typical and bright environments without distracting reflections or eye strain.
cr_list.voc: The screen should be bright and easy on the eyes, without annoying reflections.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop to have a 13–16 inch screen with a practical aspect ratio that balances comfortable workspace with portability.
cr_list.voc: A mid-size screen with enough room to work that still keeps it easy to carry.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop’s RAM and storage to be user-upgradeable and not fully soldered so I can add capacity later as my needs grow.
cr_list.voc: Let me add memory and storage myself later instead of having it all soldered in.

cr_list.cr: I need my work laptop to be physically durable and robust (chassis, materials, components) so it survives many years of daily professional use and travel.
cr_list.voc: It has to survive years of daily work and travel without falling apart.

cr_list.cr: I want my professional laptop to have enough RAM (and support for ≥32 GB where needed) so I can run IDEs, many tabs, VMs, data tools, and creative apps smoothly.
cr_list.voc: Coding tools, VMs, and a ton of tabs at once — I need plenty of memory, with room to go higher.

cr_list.cr: I need my professional laptop to offer capable graphics (integrated or discrete) appropriate to my work, from smooth multi‑monitor and video calls to demanding 3D, CAD, or AI workloads.
cr_list.voc: Graphics strong enough for my work — from multi-monitor calls to heavy 3D, CAD, or AI.

cr_list.cr: I need my professional laptop’s cooling system to keep internal components cool and prevent thermal throttling or damage during sustained heavy workloads.
cr_list.voc: Under long, heavy workloads it has to stay cool — no throttling, no cooked parts.

cr_list.cr: I want my professional laptop to be reasonably serviceable and modular (RAM, SSD, battery, fans, hinges, cooling) so it can be repaired and upgraded instead of replaced.
cr_list.voc: When a part dies, let me replace it — memory, storage, battery, fans — not the whole laptop.

cr_list.cr: I need my professional laptop to include ample, fast internal storage and options for expansion (multiple slots, large SSDs) so I can keep big projects, VMs, and datasets locally.
cr_list.voc: I keep big projects and VMs on the laptop — give me lots of fast storage and room to add more.

cr_list.cr: I want my casual‑use laptop to have enough RAM (typically at least 8–16 GB) so common multitasking with many browser tabs, streaming, and office apps stays smooth now and over several years.
cr_list.voc: Lots of tabs, streaming, and office apps should stay smooth — now and a few years from now.

cr_list.cr: I need enough internal storage, on a fast SSD, that my OS, apps, photos, and a few games fit comfortably and everyday use feels snappy.
cr_list.voc: Enough fast storage for my apps, photos, and a few games, so everything opens quickly.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop’s casing materials and finishes to resist scratches, stains, fingerprints, and peeling feet or trim so it still looks and feels good after years of daily use.
cr_list.voc: After years of use it should still look good — no scratches, smudges, or peeling rubber feet.

cr_list.cr: I’d like my laptop’s design to be practical and understated—a traditional clamshell shape with normal rectangular screen and thin bezels, without flashy gamer styling or odd geometries that waste usable screen or feel out of place at work or class.
cr_list.voc: A simple, normal clamshell with thin bezels — no flashy gamer styling.

cr_list.cr: I want my laptop’s cooling system, vents, and dust resistance to work well on real‑world surfaces like desks, laps, beds, and kitchen tables without quickly clogging or needing a cooling pad.
cr_list.voc: It should stay cool on a desk, my lap, or the bed — without clogging up or needing a cooling pad.
